scenes.headline: How every attention variant pays one of two bills
scenes.sub: MHA to MLA, sliding windows to sparse selection, FlashAttention to paged caches.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Chai! Attention has a zoo of variants. Know which bill each one pays, and the zoo becomes a map.

scenes.label: The map
scenes.text: Plain attention runs up two bills: an N by N score matrix, and a key-value cache that grows with context and depth.
scenes.say: Plain attention runs up two bills: an N by N score matrix, and a key-value cache that grows with context and depth.

scenes.title: The one operation
scenes.say: Every query scores every key, and blends the values.

parts.note: every query dotted with every key: an N by N matrix
parts.say: Every query dotted with every key. Double the context, and the work quadruples.

parts.note: keeps logits from growing with head width
parts.say: The root scale keeps softmax out of a near one-hot corner.

scenes.title: Bill one: which pairs to compute

steps.label: Bidirectional: every pair
steps.say: An encoder reads every pair, in both directions. That's the full quadratic bill.

steps.label: Causal: no future keys
steps.say: A decoder masks the future: half the square, still quadratic.

steps.label: Sliding window: only the last w keys
steps.say: A sliding window reads only recent keys and caps the cache. Stacked layers compound its reach.

steps.label: Content-based: each query picks its blocks
steps.say: Native sparse attention lets each query score the past cheaply, and read only the blocks that matter.

scenes.title: Bill two: how to pay for K/V

left.title: Share heads: MQA, GQA
items: Query heads fan into G shared KV heads
G = 1 is MQA; G = h is MHA
left.say: Grouped-query attention keeps every query head, but groups them onto a few shared key-value heads.

right.title: Compress them: MLA
items: K and V projected into one low-rank latent
Cache the latent, up-project at compute time
9/2 d_h per token, reported at or above MHA
right.say: Latent attention compresses instead: keys and values become one small latent, cached, and projected back up when needed.

steps.say: FlashAttention keeps a tile of queries in fast on-chip memory.
Key and value tiles stream past it.
An online softmax tracks a running max and sum, so the answer is exact.

steps.note: same numbers, bit for bit; only the bytes move differently
steps.say: The N by N matrix never touches slow memory.

scenes.text: Place any new mechanism on two axes, which pairs and which K/V, and you know most of what it gives up.
scenes.say: Place any new mechanism on those two axes, and you know most of what it does, and gives up.

recap: Two bills: the score matrix and the KV cache
Masks pick pairs; sharing or latents shrink K/V
FlashAttention is exact, with fewer memory trips
scenes.say: So: masks cut the matrix, sharing and latents shrink the cache, and FlashAttention moves fewer bytes.
